title: Business Development Manager
description:
1、Engage in a consultative, relationship-driven proactive sales process to focus on 20-30 prospects/accounts and be accountable to drive aggressive sales goals; Define and execute engagement strategies and tactics with the support and mentorship of the Regional BD Director; Identify and build credible relationships from the engineering level to C-level personnel required to rapidly progress the sales cycle from sensor test/evaluation stage to POC and or small field test deployments with Hesai sensors.
2、Assist in the development of a strong pipeline of new business opportunities through direct or indirect customer contact and prospecting.

1、High technical and proficient with all aspects of LiDAR sensors and complementary sensors, LiDAR technical approaches, various real world use cases from autonomous vehicles to smart infrastructure, to 3D digital imaging survey / mapping.
